For anyone who is unaware, the team responsible for this project, is also responsible for creating teritori project on cosmo. If you are unaware of the project, look it up or ask fellow cosmonaut. This team took a lot of eth and atom from their community, shipped less than 25% of the promises they made. Constantly berated community members for complaining about lack of progress, then they ghosted the community for about 6 months with zero communication from team. 

Then they came back and said their focus was now on gno.land and promised to make it right for their token and nft holders when gno goes to mainnet. Following that ann, they ghosted the community again for like 5 month, only to come back and say the project is dead. 

So, a lot of people who minted their nft on eth chain, teritori chain and held their token lost everything. I will be honest and say this app in itself is not bad, but it'd be to one's best interest to never invest into anything associated with the team.
